description: Minified Bootstrap v3.3.5 JavaScript library, providing UI components such as alerts, buttons, carousels, modals, tooltips, popovers, scrollspy, tabs, and affix. Contains code for initializing, handling transitions, and event bindings for Bootstrap's UI features.

methods.name: emulateTransitionEnd
methods.description: Simulates the transition end event for a specified duration to handle CSS transitions reliably.

methods.name: carousel
methods.description: Controls carousel behaviors like slide, next, prev, and cycle.

methods.name: collapse
methods.description: Handles show/hide toggle of collapsible elements.

methods.name: modal
methods.description: Controls modal dialog display, hide, and backdrop handling.

methods.name: popover
methods.description: Initializes and manages popover UI components.

methods.name: scrollspy
methods.description: Tracks scroll position to update navigation states.

methods.name: affix
methods.description: Controls sticky positioning of elements based on scroll.
